items.title: Public Preview: AI bot ruleset for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
items.description:
Announcing the public preview of the AI bot ruleset for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Azure Front Door Premium. 

AI crawlers and agents visit your site for different reasons, and you may want to allow some but not others. Robots.txt only works when a bot chooses to follow it, and some bots pretend to be a well-known AI crawler. The AI bot ruleset identifies AI bots, groups them by purpose, and enforces your choice for each group at the edge. 

With this preview, you can choose an action for each of four categories: 

  • AI training, for verified crawlers that collect public content to train or fine-tune AI models. 
  • AI search, for verified crawlers that index content to power AI search, answers, and summaries. 
  • AI interactive agents, for verified agents that fetch pages in real time when a person asks an AI assistant. 
  • Miscellaneous AI agents, for AI bots that can't be verified, including bots that falsely claim to be a well-known AI crawler. 

Microsoft keeps the AI bot signatures up to date, with no ruleset version change needed. Every rule starts with the Log action, so you can review your AI bot traffic in WAF logs and WAF insights before anything is blocked. You can set each category to Allow, Block, Log, JS challenge, or CAPTCHA, and configure the ruleset in the Azure portal, Azure PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Bicep. 

Learn more.

items.title: Announcing: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta
items.description:
A new Azure Databricks environment is now available in Beta on Microsoft Azure Government. It brings the modern data and AI platform from global Azure to U.S. public sector agencies and their partners, delivered as a first-party Azure service. 

The Beta includes Unity Catalog for unified governance across data and AI assets, and Databricks SQL with serverless compute for scalable analytics without managing infrastructure. It also includes system tables for usage, audit and cost visibility. The Compliance Security Profile is on by default in every workspace, Azure Private Link is required, and customer data stays in the US Gov Virginia and US Gov Arizona regions. 

The Beta is for non-production workloads only and must not be used to process Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or other regulated data. Access is enabled per subscription.  

Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: Cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Backup
items.description:
Azure Backup now supports cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines, enabling customers to protect VMs using a Recovery Services vault located in a different Azure subscription within the same tenant.

This capability allows organizations to centralize backup management across multiple subscriptions, simplifying backup administration, improving governance, and reducing the need to maintain separate backup vaults in each subscription. It is particularly valuable for enterprises managing large Azure environments with dedicated subscriptions for backup and security operations.

Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: AI-powered application and database modernization with Modernize CLI
items.description:
Modernize CLI brings application and database modernization together as one connected, agentic journey. It assesses application architecture, dependencies, and cloud readiness while discovering the databases the application relies on and invoking specialized database skills for compatibility, migration readiness, and target recommendations. The combined insights create a coordinated modernization plan spanning application code and the data layer. You can then use GitHub Copilot to remediate the application and database changes and validate the workload end to end on Azure, transforming what were traditionally separate modernization efforts into a single integrated experience. 

Learn more.
